title: Improve ReMCP device monitoring, verified telemetry controls and private diagnostic captures.
changes: Display online device CPU, RAM and disk measurements progressively from authorized saved and live samples, without waiting for a slow device to complete other batches.
Keep loading skeletons for unmeasured indicators and distinguish telemetry disabled, unavailable and pending states; retry rate-limited scans automatically.
Verify owner-requested telemetry changes across both agent and runtime on reconnect, while preserving explicitly disabled preferences.
Associate newly saved screenshots with nearby real diagnostic measurements and blur screenshot previews until the owner deliberately reveals them.
Make remote device management safer with owner-confirmed agent repair, explicit local-only stop and uninstall instructions, and bounded process inventory.
Preserve independent read-only diagnostics, account scope, screenshot headless detection and existing server-side authorization boundaries.
